label: PF Backlog 476
title: Defect/RCCA: claim-time dedup (BI-PF-0422) vs per-item parallel claim (BI-PF-0419) - develop tests-scoped RED; decide semantics
body:
Source: found while gating BI-PF-0441 (2026-10-08) - PRE-EXISTING on develop (reproduces with the 0441 edit
stashed), so develop's tests-scoped is currently RED.

Symptom: test-framework/tests/pipeline/test_assignments_api.py::test_claim_next_is_per_item_parallel and
::test_capacity_cap_denies_extra_assignment FAIL - the 2nd/3rd claim_next in one project returns
{"claimed": false, "reason": "no eligible item"}.

Root cause (5-Why):
1. Why no 2nd eligible item? scheduler.next_eligible(stage="execute") skipped items 1 and 2.
2. Why skipped? BI-PF-0422 claim-time dedup (core/scheduler.py:403-415) skips a candidate that
   _near_duplicate()s a blocker = active items + already-skipped candidates.
3. Why is item0 a blocker? it was CLAIMED by the 1st claim -> its execution.worker_id sets it "active".
4. Why do items 1/2 count as duplicates? the test seeds near-identical titles ("assignment item 0/1/2"),
   Jaccard >= PF_DEDUP_THRESHOLD (0.6).
5. Why was this not caught? BI-PF-0422 (claim-time dedup) was delivered AFTER BI-PF-0419 (per-item claim) and
   did NOT update/repair the 0419 test, and tests-scoped didn't run that file together at the time.

DECISION NEEDED (behavioral): does claim-time dedup intend to collapse a near-duplicate SET to ONE runnable
item (BI-PF-0422 intent - then the 0419 TEST DATA is degenerate and must use distinct titles), or should
DISTINCT approved items with similar titles all run in parallel (BI-PF-0419 intent - then the dedup must NOT
block candidates that only match an already-CLAIMED active item)?

Proposed fix (pending approval):
- Option A (recommended if 0422 intent stands): fix the 0419 test to seed DISTINCT titles (it tests parallelism,
  not dedup); keep dedup; ensure test_assignment_dedup.py asserts the collapse-to-one behavior.
- Option B (if 0419 intent wins): in next_eligible, do not treat ACTIVE items as dedup blockers for OTHER
  candidates (only unclaimed higher-ranked open items), so genuinely separate items run in parallel; update
  test_assignment_dedup.py accordingly.
Either way: RCCA guard = an integration test that seeds N near-identical items, claims repeatedly, and asserts
the AGREED count runs (1 for A, N for B) - so the two items' intent can never silently diverge again.

Blocks: BI-PF-0441 gate (same tests-scoped run).
